_note: Every figure the film says out loud. Each was measured off the rendered audio or read back off the wire in this session; nothing here is estimated. The spec injects them so no number is ever typed twice.

heart._detector_note: a 25%-threshold onset detector finds 17 of the 20; the soft 'dub' at velocity 88 sits under it. The number on screen is the 20 that were WRITTEN.

thunder._control: the lane-off render is the control: identical audio would have meant the automation never applied. Take 1's flat sweep was a DESIGN failure — a low cluster has no high content for a lowpass to remove — not a dead lane.

saturator._note: tanh stays gentle until the signal approaches full scale, so a source at -13 dBFS needs far more drive than the number suggests.

vowels._why_oh_missed: a filter can only amplify a harmonic that exists. At D3 (146.8 Hz) the nearest partial to 570 Hz is 440.

dj._note: each layer measured in the band it occupies; RMS alone showed the hats arriving at 0.0 dB, which is the wrong instrument for a hi-hat.
